title: Resolution urging Albany to ban harmful food additives and dyes
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass S.1239A/A.1556A, which would ban food additives potassium bromate, propylparaben and FD&C Red No. 3, and prohibit selling foods with certain artificial color additives on school grounds during school hours. It would also tighten reporting requirements for substances labeled 'Generally Recognized as Safe.' The Council says these measures would help protect New Yorkers' food safety.
